_comment: Per-style PROMPT VOCABULARY, distilled from the ORIGINAL Grok prompts that generated the baseline images (archived verbatim in original-prompts.json). The selected style's entry is injected into produce/regen briefs as the mandatory style preamble for every image prompt — replacing any hardcoded sketchnote/whiteboard wording in skill docs. The baseline image itself remains the final authority.
00-default-whiteboard: Hand-drawn sketchnote-on-paper: warm cream paper, faint pencil grid, thin black frame with corner brackets, pastel corner scribbles. Muted pastel palette (pale sky blue, mint, buttercream, dusty coral, manila tan) with charcoal linework, bouncy hand-lettered black titles, expressive stick figures, cloud thought bubbles, manila price tags, bold cross-hatched block arrows.
01-corporate-clean: Professional corporate presentation-slide illustration: clean white background with subtle light-gray grid and a thin navy header bar, bold navy sans-serif titles, rounded blue and terracotta pill badges for labels, simple flat-vector smiling figures, thick navy-outlined arrows with white text. Flat vector, high contrast, PowerPoint-ready, no hand-drawn wobble, generous margins, polished corporate style.
02-dark-executive: Dark executive slide: deep charcoal-navy background with faint geometric lines, large white-and-gold sans-serif titles, glowing cyan and coral-red pill labels, clean white line-art figures with soft cyan screen glows, bold gold-outlined arrows with white text, glowing amber-red danger accents reflecting on the dark ground, light-gray captions. Premium dark-mode SaaS / board-room style, crisp vectors, high contrast, no clutter.
03-flat-infographic: Bright modern flat infographic: soft off-white background with large overlapping pastel geometric shapes (mint, peach, sky-blue circles and rounded rectangles), bold chunky black titles, rounded-rectangle content cards in sky blue and peach-orange, flat illustration with NO outlines, oversized coral arrows with bold white text, kraft tags. Saturated but friendly colors, startup pitch-deck energy.
04-isometric-3d: Isometric presentation illustration with soft studio lighting on a pale gray-blue background: modern geometric sans-serif titles, miniature isometric scenes with mint-green structures, blue and terracotta isometric badge labels, large 3D isometric arrows with extruded text. Clean isometric vector, soft shadows, presentation-quality, not photoreal.
05-swiss-typography: Swiss International Style: stark white background, strict grid, generous negative space, a massive black grotesk title, one thin black vertical rule, small blue and red-orange rectangular labels, highly simplified black-line drawings, precise black arrows with condensed type, one small line of black caption type. Minimal, typographic, no decoration, museum-poster clarity.
06-pastel-notebook: Soft pastel notebook illustration: warm cream paper with a faint dotted grid and loose colored-pencil marks in blush, sage, and butter yellow; hand-lettered but tidy dark-brown titles; rounded blush-blue and terracotta watercolor badges; friendly rounded characters; chunky hand-painted charcoal arrows with cream text; kraft-paper tags; dark-brown rounded caption lettering. Gentle, approachable, teacher-workshop / design-thinking style.
07-blueprint-technical: Architectural blueprint: deep blueprint-blue background with white grid lines, dimension ticks, and a faint compass rose; white stencil / technical lettering; labeled schematic boxes with small callouts; technical line drawings; drafted white arrows with dashed flow lines; annotation arrows marking defects. Cyan-white on blue, engineering-drawing aesthetic, presentation-ready, not messy.
08-glassmorphism-saas: Glassmorphism SaaS slide: soft purple-to-teal gradient background with subtle light orbs, white bold sans-serif titles with a slight glow, frosted-glass cards with thin white borders and inner blur, cyan and coral labels, translucent mint elements, frosted-glass arrows, a frosted caption bar. Polished 2020s product-design look, soft highlights, high-end landing-page slide.
09-newspaper-editorial: Black-and-white newspaper editorial cartoon with limited spot color: off-white newsprint with faint column rules and ink smudges, bold condensed headlines, boxed captions, cross-hatched ink cartoons, thick ink arrows with stamped text, italic caption lines. Classic newspaper cartoon, high-contrast ink, faded red reserved ONLY for the danger element and its label.
10-brutalist-poster: Bold brutalist poster-slide: hot off-white background with thick black borders and raw stamp-like shapes, a giant condensed black title slamming across the top, raw cyan and coral rectangle stamps as labels, thick-marker drawings, massive black marker arrows with distressed white type, cardboard tags, heavy black caption type. High energy, imperfect print, poster-as-slide, startup all-hands style.
11-consulting-mckinsey: McKinsey-style consulting slide: off-white background with a thin teal header stripe, left-aligned dark-navy serif-sans hybrid titles, equal columns of light-gray boxed panels with small teal section labels, simple professional line icons, thin teal process arrows, a full-width navy insight bar at the bottom. Sparse, analytical, lots of whitespace, no decoration, consulting-deck aesthetic.
12-comic-book: Comic book page: cream ground with bold black panel borders and ben-day dots, giant explosive black comic title lettering, blue and red caption boxes, cartoon characters with classic American comic ink, huge motion-speed arrows with burst text and exclamation marks, drip/sound-effect marks, a banner caption. Limited bright colors, presentation-ready, not chaotic.
13-watercolor-keynote: Watercolor keynote: textured white paper with loose wet-on-wet washes of indigo, sage, and burnt sienna at the corners; hand-painted but readable dark-indigo titles; watercolor circle badges for labels; loosely painted figures and scenes; painted indigo arrows with white lettering; kraft tags; dark-indigo brush caption lettering. Elegant conference watercolor, not childish, generous white space.
14-chalkboard: Green chalkboard: dark green slate texture with chalk dust and faint erased marks, large white chalk title lettering with a slight smear, chalk-boxed labels, white-and-yellow chalk drawings, thick white chalk arrows, orange-brown chalk for accents and drips. Authentic classroom chalkboard look with presentation-clear lettering.
15-paper-cut-collage: Paper-cut collage: warm kraft-paper background with visible fibers, titles cut from black construction paper, light-blue and terracotta paper cards as panels, cut-out paper figures with mint and silver paper details, layered cardboard arrows with stamped text, tissue-paper drips, manila tags, and soft drop shadows under EVERY cut piece. Handmade craft aesthetic, clean composition for slides.
16-retro-memphis: 1980s Memphis design: cream background covered with scattered squiggles, triangles, and confetti in hot pink, teal, mustard, and black; bold geometric titles; teal and hot-pink squircle badges; flat characters with zigzag elements; chunky black-and-pink patterned arrows; mustard-brown drips. Playful postmodern Memphis, slide-readable, not overcrowded.
17-apple-dark-keynote: Apple keynote style: pure black background, ultra-thin San-Francisco-like typography, soft white title in title case, small muted caps labels, softly lit 3D objects floating in darkness with gentle rim light, a simple glowing white arrow with tiny caps text, one quiet line of white caption text. Minimal, cinematic, huge empty space, premium product-launch aesthetic.
18-sticky-note-workshop: Design-thinking workshop wall: light corkboard/whiteboard background with tape marks, the title on a large yellow sticky note, blue and pink-orange sticky notes as labels, sketched marker drawings on cards pinned with pushpins, an orange sticky-note arrow, a long white sticky note for the caption. Authentic workshop photoshoot look, tidy enough for a slide.
19-bauhaus-geometric: Bauhaus geometric poster: warm off-white background, primary colors only plus black, strict black geometric sans titles, blue and red rectangles with stamped labels, figures and objects built purely from circles, squares, and triangles, rows of vertical rectangles as texture, heavy black triangle-arrows, drips as vertical bars. Pure Bauhaus: red, yellow, blue, black — no gradients.
20-scifi-hud: Sci-fi HUD slide: near-black background with a faint circuit grid and scanning lines, pale cyan HUD type, modules outlined in cyan (safe) and amber-red (danger) with small status readouts (e.g. ISOLATED / EXPOSED), wireframe figures and structures, glowing data-pipe arrows with packet ticks, warning chevrons and leak particles, a bottom HUD readout bar. Clean cinematic HUD, readable labels, not cluttered with fake code.
custom: The operator uploaded their own style reference. Derive the style vocabulary by STUDYING the baseline image: name its palette, textures, lettering style, linework, lighting, and composition conventions explicitly in every prompt, and stay strictly inside that world.
